name: Blackmoore's Legacy
summary: Gol'dir is already free and carries word to Krusk in Tarren Mill. Aliden Perenolde, leader of the Syndicate, visited him and spoke of enslaving orcs who resist. Perenolde brought Elysa, who wears the pendant the Warchief desires.

sections.title: A Visit to the Prisoner
sections.body:
Gol'dir has word for Krusk after a visit from Aliden Perenolde, leader of the Syndicate. Perenolde called himself lord of the land and spoke of enslaving orcs who resist him. His father and mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned the same.

Gol'dir sends you to carry this news to Krusk in Tarren Mill. He will follow once he has settled his own business where he is.

sections.title: Elysa's Pendant
sections.body: Perenolde also brought his mistress, a slight girl named Elysa. Around her neck hung the pendant the Warchief desires.

sections.title: Krusk's Answer
sections.body: Krusk answers Perenolde's threat with anger. He vows the orcs will never submit and sets resistance alongside the effort to recover the trinket the Warchief desires. Krusk says achieving either goal will bring the other within reach.

faq.answer: Gol'dir gives this to you after you free him from the Syndicate.
Bring the news to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What did Aliden Perenolde reveal to Gol'dir?
faq.answer: Aliden Perenolde, leader of the Syndicate, told Gol'dir he meant to enslave orcs who resisted him. His father and mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned the same.

faq.q: What else did Gol'dir notice during the visit?
faq.answer: Perenolde brought his mistress, a girl named Elysa, who wore the pendant the Warchief desires around her neck.
You freed Gol'dir from the Syndicate.
